[ASVS/0x22-V14-Config.md at master · OWASP/ASVS](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v142-dependency)

> 14.2.5 Verify that an inventory catalog is maintained of all third party libraries in use.

What is the goal of this? Isn't this just the package-lock.json in the project? What is this inventory catalog meant for? If the inventory catalog is maintained, but never used for anything, it doesn't really help.

comments.body:
The purpose of SBOMs is*to share a detailed report of what components 
and vulnerabilities are in the software with customers, partners and 
internal stakeholders*. Software vendors need to make SBOM production, 
disclosure and sharing part of their everyday deployment process.

SBOM - Software Bill of Materials

Reference: 
*https://securityboulevard.com/2021/08/what-is-an-sbom-a-deep-dive/*

A SBOM is mandated within https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/presidential-actions/2021/05/12/executive-order-on-improving-the-nations-cybersecurity/ and https://www.ntia.gov/SBOM has recently taken the lead on SBOM as far as I am aware.

This issue is somewhat related to https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1039

I'd recommend submitting a Pull Request that replaces the term "_Inventory Catalog_" with "_Software Bill of Materials_" in ASVS at this time.
Good idea Christian. +1 I’d take a stand-alone PR on that  and change now if you want…

> Isn't this just the package-lock.json in the project?

For a lot of ecosystems the package manifest is not necessarily what will be resolved and included in the build. Especially if the version in the manifest specifies a version constraint as opposed to a specific version.

There's also an ecosystem where the package lock file information is only enforced when restoring packages, not when resolving packages during the build.

Can we tag this for review in a future milestone @jmanico as I suspect that @Sjord  @coderpatros  https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1066#issuecomment-941827821 plus https://www.ntia.gov/SBOM is still in flux?

We'll also need to settle the following proposals too?

- https://cyclonedx.org/
- https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/software-identification-swid/
- https://github.com/spdx

I really do not want to keep long term issues dangling. Can we please leave this closed for now since the original issue is resolved?

At the very least, if you want something new added let’s open a new issue and track these things discretely.

Is this acceptable?

> We'll also need to settle the following proposals too?

I probably wouldn't focus on specific formats (as much as I'd love a reference to CycloneDX). But rather what information is being included in the SBOM. It might make sense to just reference the V2 L1-3 requirements in SCVS https://owasp-scvs.gitbook.io/scvs/v2-software-bill-of-materials

I'll raise an issue for discussion.

Patrick,

Would you care to give a PR a go for this? Or give us a suggestion as to 
the enhanced text for this requirement?
